name: print-social-frosted-white-billboard-triptych-on-concrete-hoarding
title: Frosted Triptych Billboard on Concrete Hoarding
whatItIs: A wide billboard on a slatted concrete hoarding split into three white frosted panels: a logo, 'Smarter Payments for Everyday Life.' with orange on the last words and a rising 85% bar graphic; a glass credit card in rainbow light with 'Experience the Future of Finance.'; and 'Download the App' with a tilted phone and store badges.
whatItMeans: Three soft panels with a single orange accent tell a complete story of promise, proof and action on one board.
techniques: Orange accent words as the only colour
Frosted glass card image in the centre panel
Angled phone cropped at the corner
Store badges as the closing call to action

vocabulary.definition: Three related panels shown side by side.
A panel dedicated to the download or next step.
